Subject: Post-discovery: 30-min product demo — scheduling options

Hi Sam & Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap from our discovery call:

- Primary goals: reduce inference latency for customer-facing features, lower per-token cost, and get predictable SLAs for peak traffic.
- Constraints: sensitive PII workflows in scope — security and auditability are top concerns.
- Current infra: Mix of on-prem and cloud GPU pods; interest in a private deployment or Dedicated pool for predictable throughput.

Next step: a 30-minute product demo + brief technical deep dive to show runtime behavior, quantization options, and routing/fallback policies. Please pick one of these slots (PDT):

1) Tue, Jun 14 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT
2) Wed, Jun 15 — 2:00–2:30 PM PT
3) Thu, Jun 16 — 11:00–11:30 AM PT

Suggested attendees: Head of Eng (you), Product Lead (Priya), and whoever owns security/compliance for a 10-min security Q&A. If none of these work, propose 2–3 alternatives and we’ll align.

I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan and our short demo deck so you can share with the team. If helpful, you can also pick a slot on my calendar here: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-30min

Thanks — looking forward to the next step.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
